ideas.pitch: A Java-based offline compiler plugin that analyzes student DSA solutions during a timed assessment, automatically identifying suboptimal Big-O complexities and suggesting in-memory optimizations using custom DBMS caching layers.
ideas.title: JavaAlgoOptimizer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the core hackathon themes of Java programming, DSA, and DBMS fundamentals by evaluating algorithmic efficiency and code constraints.

ideas.pitch: An automated testing suite and benchmark tool for complex SQL queries and JDBC connection pooling, built specifically to test relational database management system performance under high concurrency constraints.
ideas.title: QueryBenchJava
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the explicit focus on DBMS technical MCQs and practical database programming knowledge tested during the online assessment format.

ideas.pitch: A procedural test case generator for competitive programming problems that creates hidden edge cases and stress-tests candidate algorithms against strict memory and time limits.
ideas.title: DSATestGenerator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Aligns with the evaluation criteria of hidden test cases and algorithmic efficiency emphasized in the hackathon's assessment guidelines.

ideas.pitch: A lightweight relational database migration and normalization validator written entirely in pure Java, featuring zero-dependency schema diffing and transactional integrity checks.
ideas.title: SchemaSyncEngine
ideas.why_it_could_win: Showcases deep practical programming knowledge in Java and relational database design, directly addressing the technical MCQ and problem-solving domains.

ideas.pitch: A high-performance concurrent data ingestion pipeline implemented in Java using custom thread pools and blocking queues, designed to simulate enterprise-grade database management systems.
ideas.title: AsyncDataPipelineJava
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates advanced Java programming concepts and multithreading fundamentals required for company-style technical assessments.
